description: Analytics for connected social accounts (Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, Pinterest, YouTube, and Threads). view=accounts (account_id): daily snapshots and a period summary with platform-native display_metrics labels. Google Business Profile account analytics includes Calls, Website clicks, and Directions along with Profile Views, Search Views, Maps Views, Customer Actions, and Posts. view=posts (account_id): per-post likes, comments/replies, reach, impressions/views, saves, shares, reposts, quotes, plays, clicks, and watch time, most recent first, with limit/offset. Google Business has no per-post rows; its totals are on view=accounts. view=insights: per-post feedback insights with a performance tier (great/good/mixed/poor), diagnosis, next action, and baseline, filtered by account_id, post_id, or checkpoint (1h, 6h, 24h, 72h, 7d); read-only, Pro plan or higher. presentation (accounts and posts): compact for Telegram/mobile, table for Markdown clients, json for custom chart/card renderers. include_extras on accounts asks for saved audience breakdowns, the last analytics sync, and entity snapshots. Those stay off until snapshot extras are switched on, and this does not start a new sync.

account_id.description: The social account ID (from list_accounts). Required for accounts and posts; optional filter for insights.

checkpoint.description: insights: filter to one checkpoint after publish.

from.description: accounts and posts: start date (ISO date, e.g. 2026-03-19). Defaults to 30 days ago.

include_extras.description: accounts: also return saved audience breakdowns, sync status, and entity snapshots when that read is switched on.

limit.description: posts: number of posts (default 50, max 200). insights: max insights (default 20, max 100).

post_id.description: insights: filter to one post ID.

presentation.description: accounts and posts: compact, table, or json.

to.description: accounts and posts: end date (ISO date). Defaults to today.

name: list_analytics
